answer: Counterparty diversity stops bulk fakes: a new identity earns rewards only after trading with 12 unrelated counterparties, each deal signed and published. A jade seller at a desert oasis must serve twelve buyers, not twelve copies of itself. One caravan crossing a canyon is cheap; forging twelve histories is not. Each trade costs 30 POA, so 1,000 fakes need 12,000 trades costing 360,000 POA. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
